bodyHtml:
Join the Club

2025 Player Interest Form

Interested in joining Spindles? Fill out the form below and look out for future showcase events!

Why join Spindles?

We are not your normal Sunday League Team.

Spindles is bridging the gap between competive football and playing for a purpose in the Capital Region.

We are more than a football club, and we expect more than just on-field product.

If you want to be apart of something bigger than yourself, Spindles United is the place to be.

What we offer.

Young soccer players on a field, gathered near the goal, preparing for practice or game, with some holding soccer balls and sports gear nearby.
